### File: `packages/link/README.md`
```md
# discohook/link

This worker is hosted on `discohook.link` and is used for linking custom link previews created by users.

## Development

- Clone the repository and navigate to this package
- Create a `.dev.vars` file and populate it:
  - `DISCOHOOK_ORIGIN` - the [origin](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URL/origin) of your Discohook process
- Install dependencies with `yarn install`
- Run `yarn dev`

```

    "dev": "wrangler dev --port=8790"

    "wrangler": "^3.0.0"

### File: `packages/link/wrangler.toml`
```toml
name = "discohook-link"
main = "src/index.ts"
compatibility_date = "2024-04-02"

[env.preview]
name = "discohook-link-preview"
route = { pattern = "preview.discohook.link", custom_domain = true }

[env.preview.vars]
DISCOHOOK_ORIGIN = "https://preview.discohook.app"

[env.production]
route = { pattern = "discohook.link", custom_domain = true }

[env.production.vars]
DISCOHOOK_ORIGIN = "https://discohook.app"

```
